formats.key: LoanOffer(uint256 offerId,address lender,uint256 fee,uint256 capacity,address nftCollateralAddress,uint256 nftCollateralTokenId,address principalAddress,uint256 principalAmount,uint256 aprBps,uint256 expirationTime,uint256 duration,uint256 maxSeniorRepayment,OfferValidator[] validators,bool lenderRefinanceDisabled,address borrower)OfferValidator(address validator,bytes arguments)
effects: The signature lets any borrower (or only `borrower` when it is non-zero) pull up to principalAmount of principalAddress from the lender, through emitLoan or refinanceFromLoanExecutionData, before expirationTime.
The lender sends (amount - fee scaled by amount/principalAmount) to the borrower's principalReceiver, so the origination fee stays with the lender.
The lender also pays the protocol fee fraction (a storage value) of that fee to the protocol fee recipient.
When capacity is non-zero, the offer can be filled again and again, each fill up to principalAmount, until the total reaches capacity. When capacity is 0, one fill cancels the offer.
The lender gets a loan tranche with aprBps interest for a duration the borrower picks, at most `duration`, backed by an NFT.

The collateral must be nftCollateralAddress and nftCollateralTokenId when there are no validators. With one zero-address validator, any token of the collection is accepted. With a non-zero validator, the validator contract and its arguments decide the collateral, and the collection address does not have to match.
The tranche is only accepted when the senior debt ahead of it, interest included, is at most maxSeniorRepayment.
When lenderRefinanceDisabled is true, the loan has a single tranche and no refinance or renegotiation can replace the lender.
formats.shown: The screen says 'Make loan offer / Lend <principal>' and shows the collection, token, loan amount, APR, duration, fee, capacity (when not 0), max senior debt, lender, expiry, a raw refinance flag, the borrower and the validator addresses.

findings.title: LoanOffer shows 'Collection' as the collateral, but a non-zero validator decides the collateral instead.
findings.evidence: MultiSourceLoan._checkValidators: `if ((totalValidators == 0 && !(matchAddress && matchTokenId)) || (isFullContractOffer && !matchAddress)) revert` — matchAddress is only enforced without validators or for the zero-address validator. Case 1 shows 'Collection: 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' and 'Token: 5016', with validator 0xff43…6d65 whose `arguments` are `visible: never`.
findings.fix: Use a label such as 'Collection (if no validator)', or put a notice in the intent that a validator sets the accepted collateral. Add a threshold-style label for the zero address, such as 'Set by validator'.

findings.title: LoanOffer interpolated intent shows one principal, but a non-zero capacity lets the offer fund many loans.
findings.evidence: MultiSourceLoan._validateOfferExecution: `if ((offer.capacity != 0) && (_used[_lender][offer.offerId] + _offerExecution.amount > offer.capacity))`; _processOffersFromExecutionData: `if (offer.capacity != 0) { _used[lender][offer.offerId] += amount; } else { isOfferCancelled[lender][offer.offerId] = true; }`. Descriptor: interpolatedIntent 'Lend {principalAmount}', capacity field `ifNotIn: ['0']` labelled 'Total capacity'.
findings.fix: Label principalAmount 'Max per loan' and capacity 'Total you may lend (reusable offer)'. Keep capacity visible and label 0 as 'Single use' if a message is possible.

findings.title: LoanOffer shows the zero-address borrower raw, but the code reads it as 'any borrower can accept'.
findings.evidence: MultiSourceLoan._processOffersFromExecutionData: `if (offerBorrower != address(0) && offerBorrower != _borrower) revert InvalidBorrowerError();`. Cases 0 and 1 show 'Borrower: 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'.
findings.fix: Hide the borrower field when it is the zero address (`ifNotIn` the zero address) and show it as 'Only borrower' otherwise. Or label it 'Borrower (0x0 = anyone)'.

findings.title: LoanOffer shows lenderRefinanceDisabled as a raw 'true' under a double-negative label.
findings.evidence: Descriptor field `lenderRefinanceDisabled` format 'raw', label 'No lender refinance'; cases 0 and 1 render 'true'. MultiSourceLoan._baseRenegotiationChecks reverts every renegotiation when the flag is set, and _processOffersFromExecutionData forces a single-tranche loan.
findings.fix: Use an enum or map on the bool, such as true → 'Loan cannot be refinanced away from you', false → 'Other lenders may refinance'.

findings.title: LoanOffer hides token id 0, so a full-collection offer does not say that it accepts any token.
findings.evidence: MultiSourceLoan._checkValidators: `bool isFullContractOffer = totalValidators == 1 && _loanOffer.validators[0].validator == address(0);` and `if (_loanOffer.nftCollateralTokenId != 0) {...}`. Descriptor: Token field `visible: {ifNotIn: ['0']}`; the zero validator shows as a raw 'Validator: 0x000…'.
findings.fix: Show the zero-address validator as 'Any token in collection' and keep Token hidden only in that case. Otherwise show token 0 explicitly.

findings.title: LoanOffer labels the duration as fixed, but it is the longest term the borrower may pick.
findings.evidence: MultiSourceLoan._validateOfferExecution: `if (offer.duration == 0 || _duration > offer.duration) revert InvalidDurationError();`. Descriptor label 'Duration'; case 0 renders '720:00:00'.

findings.title: LoanOffer tests never use a non-zero capacity, a named borrower or a full-collection offer.
findings.evidence: cases/0.json and cases/1.json both have capacity '0' and borrower 0x000…; neither has nftCollateralTokenId 0 with a zero-address validator.
findings.fix: Add cases with capacity > principalAmount, a non-zero borrower, and tokenId 0 with validator address(0).

findings.title: LoanOffer hides validator arguments, which decide which collateral backs the signer's loan.
findings.evidence: Descriptor `validators.[].arguments` `visible: never`; MultiSourceLoan._checkValidators calls `IOfferValidator(validator.validator).validateOffer(_loanOffer, _nftCollateralAddress, _tokenId, validator.arguments)`. Case 1 arguments are ABI-encoded bytes for an unknown validator.
findings.fix: No ERC-7730 format decodes validator-specific bytes. Name the known validators in local address names so the signer sees which rule applies.

findings.title: LoanOffer: the lender also pays a protocol cut of the origination fee, set in storage.
LoanOffer duration renders in hours, such as '720:00:00' for 30 days.
findings.evidence: Case 0 'Duration: 720:00:00', case 1 '1440:00:00'; the `duration` format renders HH:MM:SS.

couldNotCheck: Validator contract 0xff4313861B89E8de771CfF06466864d8CfC26d65 (case 1) has no source in the directory. Its validateOffer and arguments decide which NFT collateral the offer accepts.
